name: Caprine
tagline: Privacy-focused and elegant desktop client for Messenger
description: Caprine is an open-source Facebook Messenger desktop app packed with useful features, dark mode themes, privacy toggles (hide read receipts and typing status), and native Linux notifications.
features: Privacy controls: prevent read receipts and typing indicator indicators
Elegant dark and vibrant themes with auto system theme sync
System tray minimization and unread message counter badge
Keyboard shortcuts for fast chat switching and navigation
requirements: Linux x86_64, Facebook or Messenger account
